title: In situ molecular compensation in wide-bandgap perovskites for efficient all-perovskite tandem solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,5503-5510
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01369K, Paper
Sheng Fu, Nannan Sun, Shuaifeng Hu, Hao Chen, Xinxin Jiang, Yunfei Li, Xiaotian Zhu, Xuemin Guo, Wenxiao Zhang, Xiaodong Li, Andrey S. Vasenko, Junfeng Fang
5-AVAI, with its larger dipole and amphoteric nature, can effectively compensate for SAM-deficient interfaces and GB defects in WBG perovskite sub-cells, leading to efficient tandems.
